_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.123 — Schedule XV para 1(k): "contribution for participation in unit-linked insurance plan of Life Insurance Corporation Mutual Fund, referred to in Schedule VII (Table: Sl. No. 20 or 21), as may be notified by the Central Government", in the name of the individual, spouse or any child, or any member of a Hindu undivided family (Gazette 265620, pp.561–562) — the notification and whose name it is in are entry conditions. Counted in full: para 2 reaches para 1(a) alone (OQ-17 answered by the owner, D-154 C2a). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80C(2)(xi) (sources B21). D-154.
